author: spidey simp
description: Randomly selects Hearts of Iron IV leaders, ideological alignments, and historical empires for players looking for a new campaign or challenge.
install_msg: Thank you for installing HOI4 Random! Use `[p]load hoi4random`, then `[p]help Hoi4Random` to get started. This cog may display historical political leaders and associated imagery, including fascist leaders from World War II.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no end user data.
